# miseenplace 0.1.0

Every ask, in its place. The first release of an agent-native CLI and Agent Skills that turn the asks, promises and nudges in your chat into a triaged inbox and an audit-logged action list.

## Highlights

- `mep inbox` shows only what needs you, one line each; `mep triage` files it in one call.
- Agents cannot post free text: `draft` stores the exact words, `send` takes only a draft id.
- `mep watch` blocks until something new needs you, then exits so a background agent wakes.
- Pluggable storage (`local`, `git`, or your own) and pluggable sources (Zulip and a demo ship).
- Your sent messages, a learned style file and a verbatim request log are kept as data in your data root.
- Five skills for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Cursor. Standard library only.

## Try it

```bash
uvx miseenplace demo
```

Full list of changes: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/ankitkpandey1/miseenplace/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
